_note: Hand-labeled resolver ground truth for PEMS-BAY — the Santa Clara Valley analogue of resolver_labels.json (Phase-5 gate, >= 90%). Added in the Phase-11 correction. Until now the resolver was hand-validated on METR-LA (30 cases) and power_grid (22) ONLY, so the 96.7% figure quoted in CLAUDE.md never covered PEMS-BAY — the very cell that produced the condition-B outlier. `expected` is one of: a region label exactly as _PEMS_BAY_REGIONS emits it, lowercased; 'sensor:<id>' meaning 'resolves to exactly that sensor'; or null meaning 'must NOT resolve'. Labeled from Santa Clara Valley geography BEFORE measuring, so this is ground truth the resolver is scored against, not a description of what it happens to do.
_why_the_nulls_matter: Half the value here is the REFUSALS, and they are chosen from the two failure modes the Phase-11 investigation actually found. (a) FOOTPRINT: PEMS-BAY holds zero sensors within 5 km of San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Fremont or Palo Alto, so those names must NOT resolve — if they did, an LLM inventing Bay Area geography would score as grounded. (b) STALE COMPASS LABELS: the old degenerate names ('NW of Downtown San Jose') are directions, not places; they must not collapse onto 'Downtown San Jose', which is the mislabeling that made a citation of the target's own sector count as a causal hit.
